instruction: Determine which week recorded the top sales and shade the whole row to indicate it.

The evaluator checks if all cells in row 8 have background fill color applied, which verifies the entire row was highlighted. Custom getter reads the Excel file and checks for fill properties across all cells in the row, returning whether all cells are filled.
